capabilities: Stream music from a Navidrome or Subsonic server
Search artists, albums, and songs from one bar
Shuffle the queue or generate an endless random mix
extras: Desktop only; mobile support is planned. Credentials are stored locally and sent only to the configured server; no telemetry.
motivation: The author spends hours in Obsidian and got tired of leaving the vault to skip a track on their Navidrome server.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play music, so users with a Navidrome server must leave the vault to control playback.

relations.evidence: You'll need a running Navidrome server (or anything that speaks the Subsonic API)

requires.name: Navidrome server (or any Subsonic API server)

summary: Sidebar music player that streams a Navidrome (Subsonic API) library in the vault, with album browsing, search, playlists, and internet radio.
